document.saveAsSaveFirst: Save the current document and finish its uploads before creating a converted copy.
document.saveAsDescription: Create an independent document from version {{revision}} and retain its exact source version. The source stays unchanged.
document.saveAsRichMarkdownLoss: The Markdown copy keeps text, common formatting, code, and exact image/file versions. Block identities, alignment, and image widths are lost. Tables become tab-separated code text; merged cells, column widths, and cell formatting are lost. Images and files inside tables retain only their labels and version paths.
document.saveAsRichTextLoss: The text copy keeps text, image descriptions, file labels, and version identifiers. Bold, link styling, list layout, code languages, table formatting, and displayed images are lost. Resources are no longer embedded.
document.saveAsMarkdownTextLoss: All Markdown source characters and line endings stay intact, but display as plain text. Markdown formatting, diagrams, and relative image/file mappings are inactive in this copy; return through its source version.
document.saveAsTextMarkdownLoss: All original characters and line endings stay intact, but #, *, links, and similar content are interpreted as Markdown. No image or file mappings are added.
document.saveAsPending: The previous creation result is unconfirmed. Retry uses the same request without creating a duplicate. The title and format remain locked until confirmation.
